---
title: "Part 5 · Evidence and real data"
---

> Default concentration hyperpriors can strongly shape conclusions about heterogeneity; our
> design-conditional framework makes those choices explicit by calibrating the prior to an expected
> cluster count and checking its implied cluster sizes.

The pages below show that statement in released results. In every application the prior moves the
partition (the number of clusters, the chance of a single cluster, the largest weight) while the
unit effects stay put ([A-11](partition-vs-effects.qmd)), and the model specification can matter as
much as the prior ([A-12](partition-vs-effects.qmd#the-specification-matters-too)). Simulation
results and three applications (STAR, J = 79 schools; Bangert-Drowns, J = 48 studies; a vocabulary
checklist, N = 500), drawn only from released summaries.

| Page | Catalog | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| [Project STAR: 79 schools](star.qmd) | A-01, A-02 | School effects under five priors move by .009 RMS, while the posterior number of clusters follows the prior (posterior mean 1.96 → 4.47) |
| [Bangert-Drowns: 48 studies](bangert-drowns.qmd) | A-03 | A meta-analysis with the same pattern: posterior mean 1.89 → 3.31 clusters, collapse .548 → .190; effects and moderator slopes stay put |
| [A vocabulary test: 500 respondents](vocabulary-rasch.qmd) | A-04, A-05 | The prior sets the number of ability groups (posterior K_500 3.51 → 8.99), not the person scores (shift ≤ .031 logits) |
| [The partition moves, the effects do not](partition-vs-effects.qmd) | A-11, A-12 | Vague, TSMM and Dual-Anchor side by side (unit RMS shift .0088 STAR, .0071 Bangert-Drowns); the wide-scale prior and the HC3 input move the summaries too |
| [The simulation](simulation.qmd) | A-06 to A-09 | Nine cells, five priors: the number of clusters and collapse follow the prior, the site-effect RMSE stays .234–.238; a wrong elicited mean moves the posterior with it, and more sites do not fix the default |
| [Released data](data.qmd) | A-13 | The summary tables the evidence pages read: source, level, size, licence |
| [Static fallbacks for talks](talk-fallbacks.qmd) | A-14, A-15 | Widget stills at presentation presets and paper Figures 4 and 7; embedding in slides |
